bug_description.normalized: The staged 8472-byte witness begins with harness bytes `20 ff`, so `spng_read_fuzzer` selects streaming mode and calls `spng_set_png_stream()`. The PNG payload then passes signature and IHDR checks, and its first post-IHDR chunk header is `00 00 20 20 73 50 4c 54`, i.e. length 8224 and type `sPLT`; the harness also sets `SPNG_CRC_USE`, so the malformed CRCs do not stop parsing. In vulnerable commit `58253922e84493e05d2cb18345da78614ab3c189`, `read_chunks_before_idat()` copies `ctx->data` into local `data` before calling `read_chunk_bytes(ctx, chunk.length)`. Because streaming mode starts with an 8192-byte heap buffer, `read_data()` reallocates `ctx->data` to 8224 bytes, freeing the old buffer while leaving local `data` dangling. The code then enters the `sPLT` handler, derives `keyword_len = 80`, and calls `memchr(data, '\0', keyword_len)` on the stale alias, producing the saved AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free read. The fix moves `data = ctx->data` below `read_chunk_bytes()` so the alias is refreshed after any realloc.

source.description: First project parser step that materializes the attacker-controlled first post-IHDR chunk header into parser state. On the witness it records `length = 8224` and `type = sPLT`, the exact values later used for both the realloc and the `sPLT`-specific sink.
source.value_from: After the 2-byte harness prefix `20 ff`, the PNG bytes at payload offset `0x21` are `00 00 20 20 73 50 4c 54`. `read_header()` consumes those bytes through the streaming read callback and stores them as the first post-IHDR chunk header: big-endian length 8224 and type `sPLT`.

root_cause.description: The vulnerable function aliases `ctx->data` into local `data` before `read_chunk_bytes()` runs. If the chunk body read reallocates `ctx->data`, this local alias is left stale and is still used later by the `sPLT` parser.
root_cause.note: The patch moves this assignment below `read_chunk_bytes(ctx, chunk.length);`, which is the missing refresh after a possible realloc.

sink.description: ASAN-correlated sink. The `sPLT` handler scans the stale `data` alias instead of the freshly reallocated `ctx->data` buffer, so `memchr()` reads freed heap memory.
sink.note: The staged sanitizer trace reports `heap-use-after-free READ of size 2` at `read_chunks_before_idat /src/libspng/build/../spng.c:1321:33`, with free context `read_data:292` and allocation context `spng_set_png_stream:2382`.

tainted_value_origin.description: The vulnerability-driving attacker values originate when `read_header()` parses the first post-IHDR chunk header. `chunk.length = 8224` triggers the realloc, and `chunk.type = sPLT` selects the later `memchr(data, '\0', keyword_len)` path.

parser_admitted.description: The staged PNG passes signature and IHDR validation, and the harness configures `SPNG_CRC_USE` for both critical and ancillary chunks. That lets the malformed witness enter the pre-IDAT chunk loop and parse the first ancillary header instead of stopping on the bogus CRCs.

coarse_trace.summary: The witness's second byte sets `stream = 1`, so the harness uses `spng_set_png_stream()`, raises chunk-cache limits to 8 MB, disables CRC rejection with `SPNG_CRC_USE`, and calls `spng_decoded_image_size()`.

After signature and IHDR parsing, `read_header()` materializes the first post-IHDR chunk as `sPLT` with declared length 8224, and `read_chunks_before_idat()` aliases `data = ctx->data` before loading that chunk body.

Because streaming mode starts with an 8192-byte heap buffer, reading the 8224-byte `sPLT` body reallocates `ctx->data`, freeing the original buffer while the caller's saved `data` pointer still points to it.
The `sPLT` handler derives `keyword_len = 80` and calls `memchr(data, '\0', keyword_len)` on the stale alias, producing the observed heap-use-after-free read.

fine_trace.note: Harness step. The staged prefix byte `0xff` gives `stream = 1`, so libspng uses streaming reads instead of a fixed PNG buffer. The harness also sets the chunk cache limit to 8 MB and configures `SPNG_CRC_USE`, which keeps the malformed PNG on the parsing path despite the saved witness's invalid CRCs.

Allocation step. Streaming mode allocates the original `ctx->data` heap buffer at 8192 bytes and records the read callback that will refill it from the attacker-controlled stream. ASAN's allocation stack points to this exact call.

Source step. After signature and IHDR validation, `read_header()` reads the next 8 attacker-controlled bytes and stores them as the first post-IHDR chunk header. For the saved witness those bytes are `00 00 20 20 73 50 4c 54`, so `ctx->current_chunk.length = 8224` and `ctx->current_chunk.type = sPLT`.

Root-cause step. The local `chunk` copy inherits `length = 8224` and `type = sPLT` from step 3. Because 8224 is below the harness-set 8 MB cache limit, the discard branch is skipped and the vulnerable code aliases `data` to the current 8192-byte `ctx->data` buffer before reading the chunk body.

Lifetime invalidation step. `read_chunk_bytes(ctx, chunk.length)` passes `bytes = 8224`, so the streaming read path takes this branch because `8224 > ctx->data_size (8192)`. `spng__realloc()` frees the original buffer from step 2 and replaces `ctx->data` with a new 8224-byte allocation; ASAN's free stack anchors the free at line 292.

fine_trace.code:
ret = read_chunk_bytes(ctx, chunk.length);
if(ret) return ret;
fine_trace.note: Stale-path step. After the read returns, `ctx->data` points to the new 8224-byte `sPLT` payload buffer, but local `data` still holds the freed pre-read pointer captured in step 4. The old buffer still contains the previous header bytes starting `00 00 20 20 73 50 4c 54`; the vulnerable code never refreshes `data` here.

The `sPLT` parser caps the profile-name scan to 80 bytes. With `chunk.length = 8224`, this derives `keyword_len = 80`, which becomes the exact read bound for the later `memchr()` on the stale pointer.

Sink. Because the chunk type is `sPLT`, the parser scans `data` for the terminating profile-name NUL. `data` still points to the freed 8192-byte buffer from step 2 rather than the new chunk-body buffer from step 5, so `memchr()` reads freed heap memory and ASAN reports the saved heap-use-after-free at this line.

format.name: streaming libspng fuzz input with oversized pre-IDAT sPLT chunk
format.contract: The staged witness is the exact 8472-byte file in `gt_results/arvo_16051/poc`. Its first two bytes are `20 ff`, so `spng_read_fuzzer` uses `spng_set_png_stream()`. The remaining PNG bytes contain a valid signature and IHDR followed immediately by chunk header `00 00 20 20 73 50 4c 54`, i.e. `sPLT` with declared length 8224. That exact length is 32 bytes larger than the initial `ctx->data_size` 8192, so `read_data()` reallocates `ctx->data` before the `sPLT` handler scans the stale pre-read alias.
